item.title: I2C驱动eeprom
item.description:
STM32中使用I2C驱动EEPROM读写

背景&需求

产品有一块eeprom存储器件，存放一些基础内容，SN号，location等信息，但是考虑到存储器件不浪费，并且能够利用这些存储内容去存放一些整板维修的记录，在letter-shell的基础上添加命令，进行eeprom的读写。1024字节我写入后面512字节，8条维修记录，一条在64字节内。

eeprom型号：AT24C08C

stm32型号：STM32F1003

我们这里是AT24C08C为8Kbit，1024字节

I2C_StatusTypeDef I2C_512WriteBytes(uint8_t dev_addr, uint16_t reg_addr, uint8_t *data, uint16_t len)
{
    I2C_StatusTypeDef status;
    uint16_t i;
		
		uint8_t highaddr,lowaddr;
		highaddr = (reg_addr >> 8) & 0xFF;
		lowaddr = reg_addr & 0xFF;
	
		dev_addr |= highaddr;
	
    I2C_Start();
    I2C_SendByte(dev_addr << 1);    // 写地址
    status = I2C_WaitAck();
    if(status != I2C_OK) goto error;
    
    I2C_SendByte(reg_addr);         // 发送寄存器地址
    status = I2C_WaitAck();
    if(status != I2C_OK) goto error;
    
    for(i = 0; i < len; i++)
    {
        I2C_SendByte(data[i]);      // 发送数据
        status = I2C_WaitAck();
        if(status != I2C_OK) goto error;
    }
    
error:
    I2C_Stop();
    return status;
}

const void simple_delay_ms(uint32_t ms) {
    volatile uint32_t i, j;
    for (i = 0; i < ms; i++) {
        for (j = 0; j < 2000; j++) {  // 2000次循环约 0.5~1ms（主频不同请调整）
            __NOP();  // 空操作，防止被优化
        }
    }
}

I2C_StatusTypeDef AT24C08C_Write_CrossPage(uint8_t dev_addr, uint16_t mem_addr, uint8_t *data, uint16_t len) {
    uint16_t offset = 0;
    I2C_StatusTypeDef status = I2C_OK;

    while (len > 0) {
        // 计算当前页内的剩余空间
        uint16_t page_remain = AT24C08C_PAGE_SIZE - (mem_addr % AT24C08C_PAGE_SIZE);
        
        // 本次可以写入的字节数，取“页剩余”和“待写长度”的小值
        uint16_t write_len = (len > page_remain) ? page_remain : len;

        // 调用你的底层I2C页写入函数
        status = I2C_512WriteBytes(dev_addr, mem_addr, &data[offset], write_len);
        if (status != I2C_OK) {
            return status; // 写入失败，立即返回错误码
        }

        // 等待当前页的内部写周期完成 (AT24C08C写周期最大5ms，此处延时留有余量)
        simple_delay_ms(6);
        
        // 更新地址、偏移和剩余长度
        mem_addr += write_len;
        offset += write_len;
        len -= write_len;
    }
    return I2C_OK;
}

如何就可以实现翻页操作了。

static uint16_t Repair_Address(uint16_t Base , uint16_t Index){
	return (Base+Repair_size*Index);
}

int shellRepair(int argc, char *argv[])
{
	char readbuff[Repair_size];     // 必须数组！必须初始化！

	char initbuff[Repair_size];
	memset(initbuff, 0, Repair_size);
	memcpy(initbuff, "\r\n", 3);
	
	char write_buff[Repair_size];
	memset(write_buff, 0, Repair_size);                     // 全零填充
	write_buff[Repair_size - 1] = '\0';
	
	
	I2C_Init(GPIOB, GPIO_PIN_7, GPIOB, GPIO_PIN_6, 0);
	I2C_Switch(0);
	
	Shell *shell = shellGetCurrent();
    if (!shell) return -1;
		
//	    // 调试：打印参数个数
//    shellPrint(shell, "argc=%d\n", argc);
//    for (int i = 0; i < argc; i++) {
//        shellPrint(shell, "argv[%d]=%s\n", i, argv[i]);
//    }
	
    // 没有参数：显示所有有效记录
    if (argc == 1) {
        shellPrint(shell, "--- Repair Records ---\r\n");
        for (int i = 0; i < Repair_NUM; i++) {
						//memset(readbuff,0,Repair_size);
						I2C_512ReadBytes(device_addr, Repair_addr(i),(uint8_t *)readbuff,Repair_size);
            printf("[%d]: %s\r\n", i, readbuff);
						//memset(readbuff,0,Repair_size);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // 参数1：索引 或 "clear"
    if (strcmp(argv[1], "clear") == 0) {
        // 清除操作
        if (argc < 3) {
            shellPrint(shell, "Usage: repair clear <index|all>\r\n");
            return -1;
        }
        if (strcmp(argv[2], "all") == 0) {
            for (int i = 0; i < Repair_NUM; i++) {
							AT24C08C_Write_CrossPage(device_addr, Repair_addr(i),(uint8_t *)initbuff,Repair_size);
							printf("[%d]: %s\r\n", i, initbuff);
							//memset(readbuff,0,Repair_size);
        }
            shellPrint(shell, "All records cleared.\r\n");
            return 0;
        }
        int idx = my_atoi(argv[2]);
        if (idx < 0 || idx >= MAX_RECORDS) {
            shellPrint(shell, "Index out of range (0~%d)\r\n", MAX_RECORDS - 1);
            return -1;
        }
				AT24C08C_Write_CrossPage(device_addr, Repair_addr(idx),(uint8_t *)initbuff,Repair_size);
				//shellPrint(shell, "[%d]: %s\r\n", idx, initbuff);
				
        shellPrint(shell, "Record[%d] cleared.\r\n", idx);
        return 0;
    }

    // 解析索引
    int idx = my_atoi(argv[1]);
    if (idx < 0 || idx >= MAX_RECORDS) {
        shellPrint(shell, "Index out of range (0~%d)\r\n", MAX_RECORDS - 1);
        return -1;
    }

    // 只有索引：查看该条记录
    if (argc == 2) {
//        if (records[idx][0] == '\0') {
//            shellPrint(shell, "Record[%d] is empty.\r\n", idx);
//        } else 
				{

					I2C_512ReadBytes(device_addr, Repair_addr(idx),(uint8_t *)readbuff,Repair_size);
          shellPrint(shell, "[%d]: %s\r\n", idx, readbuff);
					//memset(readbuff,0,Repair_size);
        }
        return 0;
    }

    // 有索引和字符串：写入记录
    // 拼接剩余所有参数（支持带空格的字符串）
    char record_str[RECORD_SIZE] = {0};
    for (int i = 2; i < argc; i++) {
        if (i > 2) strncat(record_str, " ", RECORD_SIZE - strlen(record_str));
        strncat(record_str, argv[i], RECORD_SIZE - strlen(record_str));
        if (strlen(record_str) >= RECORD_SIZE) break;
    }
    if (strlen(record_str) > RECORD_SIZE) {
        shellPrint(shell, "Record too long (max %d chars)\r\n", RECORD_SIZE);
        return -1;
    }
    strcpy(records[idx], record_str);
    record_valid[idx] = 1;	
		//strncpy(write_buff, record_str, Repair_size - 1);       // 安全拷贝，留一个字节放'\0'
		AT24C08C_Write_CrossPage(device_addr, Repair_addr(idx),(uint8_t *)record_str,Repair_size); 
    shellPrint(shell, "Record[%d] saved.\r\n", idx);

    return 0;

}

SHELL_CMD_PERMISSION(0)|SHELL_CMD_DISABLE_RETURN, 
repair, shellRepair, "维修记录");

问题

1、部分I2C驱动由另外一名开发者进行开发，由于开发者写了两个驱动，一个软件I2C的驱动，另外一个HAL库的硬件I2C进行驱动，两个一起使用，发现读写有问题，后来发现两者的硬件I2C和软件I2C的GPIO驱动电平，是有不一样的，后面我摒弃了硬件I2C，使用软件I2C。
